description: Muse Wonder senior review of a finished report. Flags reasoning gaps only; never carries probabilities and never changes posteriors.

agrees_with_top.description: Whether Wonder agrees with the leading hypothesis on the stated evidence.

gaps.description: Reasoning gaps, each optionally pointing at a test to run or evidence to collect.

evidence_id.description: Evidence that should exist but does not, or that was over-read.

test_ref.description: KP test whose outcome would close the gap.
